## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build pusula.slnx`, `dotnet test --solution pusula.slnx` and the UI tests pass
- [ ] New behavior has a test; a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Test data is synthetic: no real configuration content, names, host names or IP addresses
- [ ] New or changed UI text exists in both Turkish and English
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under **Unreleased**
